title: PDL path is a directory
notes: Fixed (spec docs/error-reporting/specs/E-BOUNDARY.md). `PDLIsADirectoryError` is also an `IsADirectoryError`. Classification is on `Path.is_dir()` rather than errno, because Windows raises `PermissionError` for `open()` on a directory. `sub/` holds no `.pdl` file here, so the reply is the shape of the fix rather than a name; with one program inside it becomes `did you mean `pdl sub/main.pdl`?` and scores 3.
